details.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (as per the RBI Assistant notification on rbi.org.in).
details.pattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 60 minutes (English 30, Numerical Ability 35, Reasoning 35). Mains: 200 questions, 200 marks (English 40, Quant 40, Reasoning 40, General Awareness 40, Computer Knowledge 40). Then Language Proficiency Test (LPT). No interview.
details.syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, English Language, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
